associations.rationale: The formal type states that the generic carrier Fin N to Complex has finrank N, but it does not itself identify that carrier with V(alpha,beta) or its q-Weyl action, so it only supports the family's dimension claim.

Assuming orderOf q equals N, the formal type asserts irreducibility of the parameterized family, but it does not itself state that the family is N-dimensional, so it covers only one component of the complete claim.
